newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Aramco lifts A-888 bunker price ex-Red Sea.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco lifts A-888 bunker price ex-Red Sea.

text.p: Saudi Aramco has increased the price of A-888 bunker diesel lifted from the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Yanbu by $3 a tonne to $191 with effect March 13.
Aramco's weekly bunker price telex kept prices of its other bunker exports unchanged. A-960 from the Gulf remains at $105 a tonne and $98 a tonne from the Red Sea.
